text:
Alex Kim: Hey, accepted the org invite but only see 2 repos (public infra seems missing). It says I'm an "outside collaborator".
Devex Bot: Welcome to Redwood! If you joined with a personal GitHub account you might become an outside collaborator. Check your account emails and 2FA.
Samir Patel: Hey Alex — what's the email on the GH account you used to accept the invite?
Alex Kim: alex.kim+personal@gmail.com — I forgot to use my work email alex.k@redwood.ai. Can we switch without losing PR history?
Maria Lopez: You can add your work email to your GitHub account and then accept SSO. Steps:
```
1) Add alex.k@redwood.ai to your GitHub account (Settings > Emails)
2) Enable 2FA (we require it for org membership)
3) Accept the org invite sent to alex.k@redwood.ai
```
If you'd like we can re-send the invite to the work email. @Samir can trigger that.
Samir Patel: I can re-invite to alex.k@redwood.ai. Are you seeing a 403 when cloning private repos?
Alex Kim: Yes trying `git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/infra.git` returns 403. The invite status for the work email is "Pending" though I accepted with personal account.
Taylor Wong: Quick checklist — try these steps locally first:
```
# set your commit email
git config --global user.email "alex.k@redwood.ai"
# clear any cached creds (macOS example)
git credential-osxkeychain erase
# then try cloning again
```
Also confirm you turned on TOTP 2FA under https://github.com/settings/security
Alex Kim: I added the work email and turned on 2FA. SSO flow still blocks me: "You’re not authorized to access this organization" when clicking the invite.
Maria Lopez: OK I'm escalating to SSO/admins. In the meantime I'll add you to a temporary 'new-hires' team so you can access onboarding repos.
Samir Patel: Once Maria adds you ping me and I'll give triage access to infra so you can open PRs. If you have historical commits tied to personal email we can help add a secondary email to keep attribution.
Devex Bot: Audit log: SSO invite for alex.k@redwood.ai created at 2101234580 by Maria Lopez.
Alex Kim: I can see the infra repo now, thanks!! One question — who owns granting write to infra? Is that infra-team@redwood or do I open a request ticket?
Samir Patel: Infra-team owns write access. For quick wins, tag me in a PR and I'll review/approve. For permanent access, please request via https://redwood-internal/reqs (choose "repo access").
Alex Kim: Perfect — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
